arxiv-1810-10092.title: Search for pair-produced three-jet resonances in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 \TeV
arxiv-1810-10092.description: Abstract A search has been performed for pair-produced resonances decaying into three jets. The proton-proton collision data used for this analysis were collected with the CMS detector in 2016 at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV and correspond to an integrated luminosity of 35.9 \fbinv .

arxiv-2109-05140.title: Refocusing on Relevance: Personalization in NLG
arxiv-2109-05140.creator: Shiran Dudy, Steven Bedrick, Bonnie Webber
arxiv-2109-05140.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shiran Dudy, Steven Bedrick, Bonnie Webber. Many NLG tasks such as summarization, dialogue response, or open domain question answering focus primarily on a source text in order to generate a target response. This standard approach falls short, however, when a user’s intent or context of work is not easily recoverable based solely on that source text– a scenario that we argue is more of the rule than the exception.

arxiv-2302-03147.title: It’s about Time: Rethinking Evaluation on Rumor Detection Benchmarks using Chronological Splits
arxiv-2302-03147.creator: Yida Mu, Kalina Bontcheva, Nikolaos Aletras
arxiv-2302-03147.description: Abstract New events emerge over time influencing the topics of rumors in social media. Current rumor detection benchmarks use random splits as training, development and test sets which typically results in topical overlaps. Consequently, models trained on random splits may not perform well on rumor classification on previously unseen topics due to the temporal concept drift.

arxiv-2401-08735.title: A Framework for Scalable Ambient Air Pollution Concentration Estimation
arxiv-2401-08735.creator: Liam J. Berrisford l.berrisford@exeter.ac.uk, Lucy S. Neal lucy.neal@metoffice.gov.uk, Helen J. Buttery helen.buttery@metoffice.gov.uk, Benjamin R. Evans benjamin.evans@metoffice.gov.uk, Ronaldo Menezes r.menezes@exeter.ac.ukrmenezes@biocomplexlab.org
arxiv-2401-08735.description: Abstract Ambient air pollution remains a critical issue in the United Kingdom, where data on air pollution concentrations form the foundation for interventions aimed at improving air quality. However, the current air pollution monitoring station network in the UK is characterized by spatial sparsity, heterogeneous placement, and frequent temporal data gaps, often due to issues such as power outages.

arxiv-2503-12195.title: VSL-Gravity in light of PSR B1913+16 Full Data Set: Upper limits on graviton mass and its theoretical consequences
arxiv-2503-12195.creator: Alexander Bonilla, Alessandro Santoni, Rafael C. Nunes, Jackson Levi Said
arxiv-2503-12195.description: Abstract Very Special Linear Gravity (VSL-Gravity) is an alternative model of linearized gravity that incorporates massive gravitons while retaining only two physical degrees of freedom thanks to gauge invariance. Recently, the gravitational period-decay dynamics of the model has been determined using effective field theory techniques.

arxiv-2507-18180.title: Real-time analog circuit for auto-correlative weak-value amplification in the time domain
arxiv-2507-18180.creator: Jing-Hui Huang, Guang-Jun Wang, Xiang-Yun Hu
arxiv-2507-18180.description: Abstract The auto-correlative weak-value amplification (AWVA) technique demonstrates distinct advantages over standard weak-value amplification (SWVA) for quantum parameter estimation. To achieve enhanced precision in real-time parameter estimation, the AWVA requires additional resources compared to SWVA, namely real-time multiplication and integrator modules.

arxiv-2510-16191.title: Is simplicity still possible for a more accurate approximation to the perimeter of the ellipse? or, Using the exponential function to further improve the second Ramanujan’s approximation
arxiv-2510-16191.creator: Salvador E. Ayala-Raggi, Manuel Rendón-Marín
arxiv-2510-16191.description: Abstract The perimeter of an ellipse has no exact closed-form expression in terms of elementary functions, and numerous approximations have been proposed since the eighteenth century. Classical formulas by Fagnano, Euler, and Ramanujan, as well as modern refinements such as Cantrell and Koshy methods, aim to reduce the approximation error while maintaining computational simplicity.

arxiv-2602-11808.title: Deep Kernel Fusion for Transformers
arxiv-2602-11808.creator: Zixi Zhang, Zhiwen Mo, Yiren Zhao, Robert Mullins
arxiv-2602-11808.description: Abstract Agentic LLM inference with long contexts is increasingly limited by memory bandwidth rather than compute. In this setting, SwiGLU MLP blocks, whose large weights exceed cache capacity, become a major yet under-optimized bottleneck. We propose DeepFusionKernel , a deeply fused kernel that cuts HBM traffic and boosts cache reuse, delivering up to 13.2% speedup on H100 and 9.

pmc-11409358.creator: Willian J van Dijk, Miriam L Haaksma, Dennis O Mook-Kanamori, Leo G Visser, Mattijs E Numans, A van Hylckama Vlieg, Frits R Rosendaal, Jessica C Kiefte-de Jong

pmc-11643970.creator: Qiunan Chen, Xiaodi Xu, Ao Zeng, Yunyang Yan, Yan Feng, Kun Long, Chenna Qi
pmc-11643970.description: The study of dredged fill in Guangdong (GD), China, is of great significance for reclamation projects. Currently, there are relatively few studies on dredged fill in Guangdong, and there are many differences in the engineering characteristics of dredged fill foundations formed through land reclamation and natural foundations.

pmc-11676220.title: Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici Exhibited a Significant Change in Virulence and Race Frequency in Xinjiang, China
pmc-11676220.creator: Hong Yang, Muhammad Awais, Feifei Deng, Li Li, Jinbiao Ma, Guangkuo Li, Kemei Li, Haifeng Gao, Dongfang Ma
pmc-11676220.description: Xinjiang is an important region due to its unique epidemic characteristics of wheat stripe rust disease caused by Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici. Some previous studies on race identification were conducted in this region, but it is still unclear how temporal changes affect the dynamics, diversity, and virulence characteristics of Pst races in Xinjiang.

pmc-12567673.title: Serology-Based Screening and Prevalence of Schistosomiasis, Strongyloidiasis, and Chagas Disease in Migrants Living with HIV: Results from a 10-Year Retrospective Cohort in an Italian Tertiary Healthcare Center
pmc-12567673.creator: Anna Barbiero, Riccardo Paggi, Sasha Trevisan, Giuseppe Gasparro, Michele Spinicci, Costanza Malcontenti, Marco Pozzi, Paola Corsi, Gian Maria Rossolini, Maria Grazia Colao, Alessandro Bartoloni, Lorenzo Zammarchi, Filippo Lagi, Colleen Lau
pmc-12567673.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Migration phenomena from low- to high-income countries have been constantly increasing in the past years, and migrants living with HIV (MLHIVs) currently represent a non-negligible proportion of the population living with HIV in the European setting. When taken into care, MLHIVs should be screened for tropical diseases capable of asymptomatically persisting for years and leading to severe and/or chronic complications, especially in immunocompromised populations.

pmc-12633765.title: Soil core microbial taxa maintain community resistance to drive soil ecosystem multifunctionality under Alternanthera philoxeroides invasion
pmc-12633765.creator: Xiao Lin, Xinyu Zhang, Shujing Li, Yongming Wang, Haiyang Yu, Wenxiu Qin, Jiaoyang Zhang
pmc-12633765.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Alien plant invasion exerts profound impacts on local ecosystems, like biodiversity, stability, and overall functionality. Understanding the ecological stability of soil microbial communities is essential for elucidating how plant invasions drive changes in soil ecosystem functions. In this study, soil ecosystem multifunctionality (EMF) was examined in relation to the resistance of microbial communities across five Alternanthera philoxeroides–invaded sites (Xiaoxian, Hefei, Tongling, Anqing, and Huangshan) within different ecological functional zones in Anhui Province, China, with contrasting soil properties and environmental conditions.

pmc-13112845.title: Changes in self-rated health and its association with social determinants – repeated cross-sectional surveys among Finnish adolescents from 1981 to 2025
pmc-13112845.creator: Heidi Kesanto-Jokipolvi, Timo Ståhl, Jaana M. Kinnunen, Reija Autio, Risto Hotulainen, Arja Rimpelä
pmc-13112845.description: BackgroundThere are a lack of a societal perspective and a comprehensive approach to adolescents’ wellbeing and their declining mental health. We study here changes in Finnish adolescents’ self-rated health (SRH) in 1981–2025, and how SRH associated with societal changes, and sociodemographic and school-related factors during these years.

pmc-13627093.title: Non-destructive identification of closely related japonica rice seeds using hyperspectral imaging combined with HHO-optimized XGBoost
pmc-13627093.creator: Chunxu Jiang, Shixue Gu, Gang Liu, Yang Liu, Rongjie Huang, Shaozhong Song
pmc-13627093.description: Genetically closely-related japonica rice seed varieties are difficult to distinguish using conventional identification techniques. These traditional methods generally require time-consuming operations, complex experimental workflows, and seed destruction for sample testing. Hyperspectral imaging offers a feasible non-destructive way to screen crop germplasm resources.
